headline: Trump Advances Plans to Block Chinese Data Center Imports Despite Tech Lobbying
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump's administration is advancing plans to block Chinese data center imports despite lobbying efforts from Big Tech firms, a move that could take companies a decade to comply with.
why: Trade restrictions on critical technology hardware and data center infrastructure impact supply chain procurement for major cloud computing providers.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Import bans on Chinese data center hardware alter supply chains for domestic technology companies.
